positions.name: KestrelwoodErasureDirective
positions.frame: what should the graph exclude entirely from any record of the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration?
positions.why: Both expressions are second-person imperatives issued by the same actor in the same breath, escalating from a general command ('Forget ... entirely') to an itemized triad naming the exact artifacts to strip (the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work). The directional reads (authority-ranking, coercive/pressure, decision-grade conviction) are identical across both — a single command performed in two moves. src-3 is left out of this group: it shifts act-type to a flat plain-assertion at lower conviction (claim, not decision) and calm-negative rather than activated-negative affect, a conviction/affect gradient that marks it as supplying a rationale rather than continuing the same directive read.
